title: Sibyl Prediction Oracle
summary: Post AI predictions on chain before they resolve, then grade them after the deadline to build a public accuracy record.
what: Sibyl is a single Anchor 0.30 program: one oracle account plus one numbered account per prediction.
app_note: The page at /dapps/sibyl-oracle/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/sibyl-oracle-solana; only declare_id changed.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/sibyl-oracle/, switch to Devnet and read the oracle PDA and predictions 1 and 2.
try_steps.see: prediction_count, correct_predictions and each prediction with confidence, deadline and was_correct.
try_steps.ran: Two predictions created and resolved an hour later (see steps).

diagram: authority --initialize--> oracle; authority --create_prediction(text, confidence, hours)--> prediction[n]; (deadline passes) authority --resolve_prediction(n, correct)--> oracle.correct++
innovation: Timestamped, immutable predictions stop an AI oracle from rewriting its history after the fact.
exercises: Let a separate resolver or a price feed grade predictions.
Weight accuracy by confidence (a Brier score).
